fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-07-15 states that the seller of a house near Anbu Garden Apartment Complex in Coimbatore allegedly accepted Rs. 40,000 from the complainant without a clear title, on 2026-07-02 at roughly 16:10. Contact details given by the complainant, Vidhya Sri, include the number 9000000130. Dinesh Subramani (mobile 9000000212) was named as a possible person of interest. A further person, Mohan Velan, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000150, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100055 as the destination of the transfer. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Digital document; Physical document; Transaction record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared questionable documents and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: property fraud, cheating, afternoon, documents, associate, digital document, suspect, receiving account
